meta.title: Pixel Matrix — Casual Brain Games Together
meta.description: A pixel-art reflex game you can play alone or with friends, straight from your phone's browser.

landing.title: Pixel Matrix
landing.intro: Tap the pixels matching the target colour before they fade. The faster you are, the more points you score.

howTo.step1: Check the target colour at the top.
howTo.step2: Tap pixels of that colour before they fade.
howTo.step3: The target colour keeps changing — stay sharp.
howTo.step4: Wrong tap: you lose points and one life.

solo.title: Solo
solo.tapToStartHint: 3 lives. A wrong tap costs one.

auth.title: Account
auth.guestNote: Without an account you can still play everything as a guest — your history just is not saved.

err.usernameChars: Username can only use letters, numbers and underscores.
err.passwordLength: Password must be at least {min} characters.
err.usernameTaken: That username is taken. Try another.
err.noDatabase: Accounts are not enabled on this server. You can still play as a guest.

auth.gateAccountNote: Your solo record and match history are saved, and your name joins the leaderboard.
auth.gateGuestNote: Start right away, no sign-up. Nothing is saved.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.subtitle: Highest solo records. Only players with an account are listed.
leaderboard.empty: Nobody has scored yet. Be the first!

profile.title: Profile
profile.noMatches: No saved matches yet. Go play with friends!
profile.guestOnly: You are playing as a guest, so nothing is saved. Create an account from the home page if you want your history recorded.

gold.title: Gold Pixel
gold.body: Worth {multiplier}× the points, and ANY colour counts — it does not have to match the target. Short-lived, so do not hesitate.

life.title: Life Pixel
life.body: Adds 1 life, up to {maxLives}. Only appears when you are short on lives, and it is rare. Do not miss it.

bomb.title: Watch for Bombs
bomb.body: The dark pixel with a red border. Tapping it costs {lives} lives at once and breaks your combo. Just let it fade — ignoring it is never punished.

dualTarget.title: Two Target Colours
dualTarget.body: From now on there are TWO target colours at once. Both score. The number of target pixels stays the same — what grows is tracking two colours at once.

chaos.title: Chaos Mode
chaos.body: The difficulty curve has maxed out. From here each level turns on one random twist: faster spawns, hidden glyphs, doubled bombs, or shuffled positions. Its name shows in the HUD.
